acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Bears family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Cave Bear, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Maul-Line Soldier archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Massive cave-adapted bear with high shoulders, dense dark coat, worn claws, and pale muzzle scars.
Signature mechanic: Crossed Maul: protected advance ends when both forearms open into a fixed two-swipe sequence.
battlefieldDuty: Advance behind crossed forelegs, absorb frontal pressure, then open into a two-paw maul.
constructionDimensions: Heat-blackened guard hairs part around ember seams at the shoulders, palms, and chest without consuming the coat.
Smoke rolls with body mass and brief flame fronts follow swipes, drags, and falling terrain in the committed direction.
counterplay: Attack from the rear quarter or disengage until the second swipe exhausts and exposes the chest. Affinity signal: The loaded joint brightens, then exposes a cooling dark-red seam during the ordinary recovery window.
forbiddenTreatments: Combustion that hides paws, claws, or shoulder motion
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged ursine body, plantigrade paws, compact tail, broad muzzle, dense coat, and weight-bearing shoulder hump.
Escalation uses coat condition, scars, claw specialization, posture, and environmental interaction rather than humanoid equipment.
Raised shoulders, planted hind legs, open chest, and exposed inner wrists preserve readable commitment and recovery windows.
telegraph: The forearms cross, claws scrape, and its chest expands before opening.
